q_and_a.a: No. Every print ships unframed with a 1/4 inch white border and is sized to fit a standard off-the-shelf frame (12x18, 16x24, 20x30 or 24x36 inches).

q_and_a.q: What paper is it printed on?
q_and_a.a: Museum-grade matte fine-art paper, 175 gsm, with archival pigment inks rated for decades without fading.
Each print is made to order in the USA in 2 to 5 business days, then ships tracked and arrives in 3 to 5 business days. US shipping is a flat $6.90 and free on orders over $75.
Send a photo within 30 days of delivery and we reprint and reship it free of charge, or refund you in full.
Series 01 is black ink on warm off-white paper; Balance and Orbit carry a muted rust-red accent and Meridian a deep navy. Printed colours match the product photos closely.
